title: Application AuthProxy OAuth2Proxy Entity
description: OAuth2 Proxy-specific configuration. Extends Application/AuthProxy with OAuth2 Proxy settings.

client_secret_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for OAuth2 client secret.

oidc_issuer_url.description: OIDC discovery URL for the identity provider.

pass_access_token.description: Whether to pass the OAuth2 access token to the upstream.

pass_user_headers.description: Whether to pass X-Forwarded-User and similar headers to the upstream.

whitelist_domains.description: Domains allowed for redirect after authentication.
